Measured on 2026-11-21 with dspk 0.0.13, on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 with Max-Q Design · Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) · Linux 7.3.4-300.fc45.x86_64.

Pre-autotuned 384x300000 (10.0s @ 30kHz) float32 block; median of 5 calls end-to-end from NumPy (upload + kernel + download); SciPy/NumPy in float64.

## Time (ms)

| Operation | CUDA | wgpu | CPU runtime | SciPy / NumPy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| zero-phase IIR bandpass | 949 | 1224 | 1265 | 5021 |
| causal IIR bandpass | 935 | 1205 | 1046 | 2496 |
| notch 60 Hz (Q=30) | 1063 | 1314 | 1285 | 5155 |
| FIR 101 taps (causal) | 1011 | 1195 | 1136 | 3755 |
| FIR 101 taps (centered) | 1022 | 1135 | 977 | 6527 |
| FIR 257 taps (Pipeline cached) | 1172 | 1395 | 1476 | 16594 |
| Gaussian smooth (sigma=2) | 938 | 1248 | 1022 | 1252 |
| median filter (width=5) | 894 | 1255 | 857 | 3585 |
| Teager-Kaiser energy | 957 | 1211 | 872 | 4765 |
| resample_poly (1/3) | 752 | 953 | 739 | 2630 |
| CAR (common average ref) | 969 | 1095 | 1031 | 415 |
| CMR (common median ref) | 1025 | 1309 | 1968 | 4831 |
| ZCA local-kNN (apply) | 1013 | 1267 | 1694 | 1258 |
| Surface Laplacian (apply) | 1225 | 1258 | 1049 | 1517 |
| Fused Pipeline (i16->BP+CAR+ZCA) | 1271 | 1479 | 2259 | 11537 |

Most of each dspk time is the 92 MB transfer to the device and back. Chaining stages in a [pipeline](/dsp-kitchen/operations/pipelines/) pays for that transfer once.

## Agreement (largest difference, relative to SciPy's peak)

| Operation | CUDA | wgpu | CPU runtime | Tolerance | Passed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| zero-phase IIR bandpass | 1.9e-06 | 1.9e-06 | 1.9e-06 | 1e-05 | yes |
| causal IIR bandpass | 1.4e-06 | 1.4e-06 | 1.4e-06 | 1e-05 | yes |
| notch 60 Hz (Q=30) | 4.5e-06 | 3.2e-06 | 3.7e-06 | 1e-05 | yes |
| FIR 101 taps (causal) | 6.7e-07 | 6.7e-07 | 6.7e-07 | 1e-05 | yes |
| FIR 101 taps (centered) | 6.9e-07 | 6.9e-07 | 6.9e-07 | 1e-05 | yes |
| FIR 257 taps (Pipeline cached) | 1.1e-06 | 9.0e-07 | 1.1e-06 | 1e-05 | yes |
| Gaussian smooth (sigma=2) | 3.3e-07 | 3.3e-07 | 3.3e-07 | 1e-05 | yes |
| median filter (width=5) | 0.0e+00 | 0.0e+00 | 0.0e+00 | 1e-06 | yes |
| Teager-Kaiser energy | 4.8e-08 | 4.8e-08 | 4.8e-08 | 1e-06 | yes |
| resample_poly (1/3) | 4.6e-07 | 4.6e-07 | 4.6e-07 | 1e-05 | yes |
| CAR (common average ref) | 5.1e-07 | 5.4e-07 | 5.1e-07 | 1e-05 | yes |
| CMR (common median ref) | 5.0e-08 | 5.0e-08 | 5.0e-08 | 1e-06 | yes |
| ZCA local-kNN (apply) | 4.3e-07 | 4.3e-07 | 4.3e-07 | 1e-04 | yes |
| Surface Laplacian (apply) | 9.6e-08 | 9.6e-08 | 9.6e-08 | 1e-04 | yes |
| Fused Pipeline (i16->BP+CAR+ZCA) | 1.8e-06 | 1.8e-06 | 1.8e-06 | 2e-04 | yes |

dspk works in float32 on the device, and SciPy in float64, so filters agree to float32 level. Median and common median reference are exact.

## Run it yourself

```sh
uv run python benchmarks/signal-operations/scipy_timing.py --repeats 5
```

Build with `maturin develop --release` first, and run each benchmark in a fresh process.
